annotations.title: Sector market cap and volume over time

description: Returns the tracked companies as one market over time: combined market cap, the weight of each segment or company, and traded dollar volume, daily for up to a year or weekly over five years; or, with `view: 'map'`, one session company by company (market cap, dollar volume, day change). Use it when the user asks how the sector, a segment or a company's weight has changed over a period, or where trading volume is going. A past day's market cap is that day's close (adjusted for share splits only) × the shares outstanding at that date from SEC filings; the last point is today's. Amounts in US dollars, weights as fractions. `enteredOn`: first session of a company listed during the period (an IPO, not a data gap). For today's snapshot, use get_market_overview.

date.description: Map: a session date (YYYY-MM-DD) among the last 40; default the latest.

points.description: Series: keep at most this many points, evenly spaced from the end (default 60, max 400).

sector.description: Series: 'all' (default) breaks the universe down by segment; a segment id — compute, platform, software, power, memory, equipment, interconnect, systems, neocloud, optics, other — breaks that segment down by company.

view.description: 'series' (default): totals and their breakdown over time. 'map': one session, company by company.

name: get_market
title: Sector market cap and volume over time
